description: This file sets up and runs a conversational AI bot using Langchain, OpenAI, and custom audio processing components. It defines the bot's pipeline, event handlers, and transport configuration, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and message history management.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context information for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for WebSocket over FastAPI.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including signal handling.

methods.name: get_session_history
methods.description: Retrieves or creates chat message history for a session.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the conversational bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, setting up transport and starting the run.
